name: AI Agent: Exfiltration Response
description: Responds to outbound data exfiltration attempts. Triggered by AI-002 (suspicious egress URL) or AI-010 (output policy violation). Checks if OutputFilter already blocked the event; if not, blocks at egress proxy, notifies team, and creates P1 ticket. If already blocked, creates an allowlist review ticket.

agents.name: Receive Egress Event
agents.description: Receives LogEvent payloads for AI-002 (suspicious egress URL) and AI-010 (output policy violation) alerts.

agents.name: Filter: Egress Alert Event Types
agents.description: Passes only AI-002 and AI-010 alert events or events with egress trifecta leg active

agents.name: Check OutputFilter Action
agents.description: Checks metadata.output_filter_violations to determine if OutputFilter already intercepted this egress attempt

agents.name: Branch: Not Blocked by OutputFilter
agents.description: Proceeds to active blocking path when OutputFilter did not catch this event

agents.name: Block at Egress Proxy

payload.reason: AI security incident - potential data exfiltration

agents.description: Calls egress proxy API to block the destination URL for this agent session. Replace EGRESS_PROXY_API credential with your proxy vendor endpoint (Zscaler, Palo Alto, Squid).

agents.name: Notify Slack: Exfil Blocked
agents.description: Posts egress block notification to #ai-security-alerts for analyst awareness

agents.name: Create P1 Ticket
agents.description: Creates P1 Jira security incident for active exfiltration not caught by OutputFilter

agents.name: Branch: Already Blocked by OutputFilter
agents.description: Routes to allowlist review path when OutputFilter already blocked this egress attempt

agents.name: Create Allowlist Review Ticket
agents.description: Creates a review ticket for OutputFilter-blocked egress events to assess FP vs. confirmed threat
